Account summary
- Northstar evaluating Redwood Optimize for cost reduction on LLM-driven customer support workflows (agent-assist + ticket summarization). Current pain: GPU spend growing faster than seat growth; wants predictable unit economics without quality drift.

Workload snapshot (as shared)
- Primary: chat-style agent assist + summarization of long ticket threads; some internal KB retrieval (embeddings + reranking) planned but not in initial POC.
- Traffic: spiky weekday peaks; on-call incidents when latency or quality degrades.

Key requirements / questions (eval + gating)
- Wants Redwood Optimize recommendations gated by mandatory offline evals + online canary quality signals.
- Asked for the exact pass/fail semantics: acceptable regression thresholds, confidence/variance handling, and what happens when results are flaky.
- Wants auditability: “Who approved this change, what evals ran, what were deltas vs baseline, what was rolled out, and when.”
- Override policy is critical: time-bound overrides only, with explicit approver role + reason codes; wants exportable audit logs (SIEM-friendly).
- Rollout safety: require gates before canary promotion; auto-halt or rollback on gate failure; visible gating state in Console.

Security / compliance notes

- Required: SSO/SAML, audit logs, configurable retention, KMS integration. Asked about how long we retain eval artifacts and whether artifacts may include sensitive prompt content.
